06 · A LITTLE POEM FOR YOU

For Gracy...
My Self-Proclaimed Best Friend

It began with a server, a random late night,
Two strangers talking till morning's first light.
We talked so much, forgot who could see...
The whole damn server had a front-row seat.

Then came that hometown, the strangest surprise,
A little shared place hiding in disguise.
We panicked—“Delete it, before we get doxxed!”
And somehow, that chaos became our first bond.

Then came the DMs, the laughter, the days,
The silences too, yet the bond always stayed.
U left, I missed u, more than I'd confess,
Then u built ur own place and invited me nonetheless.

Somewhere through chaos, through sorrow and strain,
We learned how to shelter each other from pain.
U had ur dark days, I had mine too,
Yet somehow I found a little more light in u.

Now ur chasing a dream that refuses to die,
Medicine calling, and ur reaching for the sky.
A setback couldn't make ur determination cease...
U chose the harder road, still chasing the white coat of ur dreams.

U study, u struggle, u sometimes feel low,
But I hope u remember how far u can go.
And when u become the doctor u promised you'd be,
I'll proudly say, “Yeah, that annoying girl? She knows me.”

Of course, ur still chaos dressed up as grace,
Spamming “AchhaChutiye” all over the place.
U annoy every bhaiya with effortless flair,
Then smile like an angel who wasn't even there.

And me? I'm still ur self-appointed best friend,
A title u never gave me, yet one I won't amend.
Maybe I'm biased, maybe slightly insane...
But losing u from my life? Not an option I'd entertain.

So here's to ur laughter, ur dreams, ur fire,
To every wild joke and every stubborn desire.
May life be as beautiful as the soul u conceal,
And may u become everything u've dared to dream and feel.

Happy Birthday, Gracy. ❤️

Stay chaotic. Stay brilliant. Stay u.

And when ur finally a doctor someday,
I'll still be here... to brighten ur day.
